record.question: The newly improved Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Project will be implemented with the assistance of
record.explanation: Answer B: World Bank. The contemporaneous Indian Rural Water Supply and Sanitation Project for Low Income States was approved on 2 January 2014 with World Bank assistance. The official Cabinet release identifies the programme in Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand and Uttar Pradesh and the World Bank IDA credit. Historical/source note: Interpreted as the Indian low-income-states project approved in January 2014; the source abbreviates its programme title. Reference: https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/PrintRelease.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=102268. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical facts are anchored to the original exam; no matching examiner key is asserted.
